title: HookEventData
description:
The `data` of a `hook.*` event (7.3): whose hook it was, where, and for which run.

```json
{"session_id": "t1", "cwd": "/Users/me/project"}
```

cwd.description:
The session's working directory: the hook JSON's `cwd`, else rlxd-hook's; empty
when neither is known.

run_id.description: The run the hook belongs to, for a run's `pre-tool-use` (5.1).

session_id.description: Claude Code's session id, from the hook's JSON; empty when it named none.
